title: finding: the pre-objectstack#10235 sortability compatibility floor is now duplicated across three files, with its deletion tracked only in source comments
body:
Observation filed while implementing #6108. Not a defect today — a scheduled deletion with nothing tracking it.

## What exists

Every consumer of the served per-column sortability projection carries the same compatibility branch: when `readObjectSortability(schema)` returns `undefined` — no `sortability` key was served at all — the consumer falls back to reading `UNMATERIALIZED_FIELD_TYPES` / `isUnmaterializedFieldType` off the field's `type`. `undefined` means "no signal was served", not "nothing is sortable", so the branch is correct and necessary today.

At `27f9d10f6` there are **four** copies of it:

| File | Site |
|---|---|
| `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` | `withSortability` (landed by #5729) |
| `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` | the toolbar sort picker's `platformSortable` (#6108) |
| `packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` | `withheldFromServerSort`, serving both sort entry points (#6108) |

(three files, four call sites — `RelatedList`'s single predicate feeds the embedded table's headers and the `data-list` sort-button row.)

## Why it is worth a card

`ObjectGrid`'s comment already says what the plan is, and #6108 copied that sentence into the two new sites verbatim:

> This branch is a compatibility floor, not a second judge: the moment a backend serves the signal it is unreachable, and it is meant to be deleted when the supported floor passes that release.

So there is a planned, coordinated deletion across three files, whose trigger is a backend-support-floor decision, recorded only in source comments. Nothing schedules it, and nothing will notice when the trigger arrives. Deleting it also retires the last consumer of `isUnmaterializedFieldType` on the sort axis, which is the point at which "virtual ⇒ unsortable" stops being re-derivable in this repo at all.

Not urgent, and explicitly NOT a request to delete the branch now — the floor is load-bearing while any supported backend predates objectstack-ai/objectstack#10235. This is a placeholder so the cleanup is triaged when the floor moves, rather than rediscovered.

Refs: #6108 · #5729 · #3950 · objectstack-ai/objectstack#10235
